_readme: Aviara Beauty Academy — Brooklyn's lash education arm. The Combo Lash Course curriculum, kit contents, and $899 price are verbatim from the archived Wix store. The other three courses were listed on the old store but their product pages did not render server-side, so their prices could not be recovered: price=null shows 'Ask about pricing'. Fill them in and they display.
intro: Southern California's premier eyelash extension training program, taught by Brooklyn Boris — 15-year lash artist and founder of Flirt Lash Lounge & Day Spa. Her knowledge, experience, and five-star student reviews guarantee a one-of-a-kind learning experience.
pitch: Get ready to learn from the best, be your own boss, earn up to $100 an hour, and enjoy making others feel beautiful.

instructorNote: This course is taught by Lash Expert & Flirt's Founder, Brooklyn Boris. Brooklyn has accumulated over a decade of hands-on experience creating lash magic in Southern California as well as Melbourne, Australia. She enjoys supporting and encouraging others to chase their dreams.
ctaNote: Class sizes are kept small so everyone gets hands-on time. Call the lounge to check the next available date.
